content.title: Is Walmart Open on MLK Day 2026? Details on Holiday Hours
content.text: If your MLK Day plans include a stop at Walmart, here's what to know about store hours for Monday, Jan. 19. Jan. 18, 2026, 2:00 PM CSTCreate your free account or log in to save this articleEach year on the third Monday in January, Martin Luther King Jr. is remembered with a federal holiday. The date was chosen to coincide with the civil rights leader's birthday, which falls on Jan. 15. The day was set aside by Ronald Reagan back in 1983 and is intended to recognize King's legacy and achievements. The January holiday is often marked with parades, ceremonies and events, as well as being designated as a national day of service in which community members are encouraged to volunteer in honor of King's many contributions. Because it's a federal holiday, many schools, businesses, financial institutions and government agencies (including the USPS), are closed on MLK Day, as well as the U.S. stock markets.But what about Walmart? Is the retail giant open on Martin Luther King Jr. Day?See below to find details on Walmart's MLK Day hours for 2026, along with how to confirm open and close times at a Walmart near you this Monday, Jan. 19. Is Walmart Open on MLK Day 2026?Walmart typically closes on two holidays annually. They are: Thanksgiving and Christmas. On Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Walmart stores will be open during normal business hours, which are typically 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.Walmart Pharmacy, Vision and Auto Care HoursWalmart store service hours may vary by location. However, many pharmacies will close at their usual time, which is 7 p.m. Vision centers will also close at their normal time, which is usually 7 p.m.Auto centers and other store services will also operate normally on Monday, Jan. 19. Find a Walmart Near YouTo ensure your local store is open this MLK Day, confirm hours ahead of going. To find a Walmart near you, double check hours or learn additional details on store services, use the Walmart directory, which you'll find right here.
